Nasus.gap_summary: Closed: P Soul Eater lifesteal is now a self-heal rule — Nasus added to HEALING_RULE_CHAMPIONS and a derive_self_healing branch heals 12%/18%/24% (based on level) of the post-mitigation physical basic-attack/on-hit damage dealt, matching the engine's lifesteal eligibility. API evidence: 4 Soul Eater heals of 14.7 = 0.24 x 61.25 per-auto at level 18, 0.12-ratio at level 6 (tests/test_p1_review_1.py).

Yasuo.gap_summary: Closed: P Way of the Wanderer's Intent is now priced — the module emits a crit_modifier payload (crit_chance_multiplier 2.0, crit_damage_multiplier_factor 0.9, excess_crit_bonus_ad_per_percent 0.5) from the cached P prose ('total critical strike chance is doubled from all other sources ... every 1% critical strike chance in excess of 100% is converted into 0.5 bonus attack damage ... critical strikes deal only 90% of the critical damage champions usually have'; the 0.9 factor is also the champion game stat criticalStrikeDamageModifier), and the fight engine applies it once in _apply_stat_buff_ultimates so autos AND ability crits share the converted values. Steel Tempest splits the flat 20-120 base (never crits) from the crit-eligible 105% AD portion ('Steel Tempest's damage based on its AD ratio can critically strike'). API evidence: 25%+25% item crit -> doubled to 100% with 2.07 = 0.9 x 2.30 per-auto (tests/test_p1_review_1.py). Flow shield stays a documented state row.
